oracle.description: templates/dispatch/tests/test_dispatch_release_body.py decides correctness: 22 fixtures, and nothing outside dispatch_release.py. Written from the spec row by an author with no access to any implementation.

purpose: Give the L-1 driver a bounded PR body and put the receipt on the packet branch, in templates/dispatch/scripts/dispatch_release.py. The receipt file IS the body today and receipts run to 165 KB against GitHub's 65536-character limit, so gh pr create has failed on every candidate the loop has produced. Add "receipt-capture" as the FIRST entry of PR_STEP_NAMES, before "commit", because the captured files have to be inside the commit. Add a secret-scan function that takes text and returns the NAMES of the patterns that matched, never the matched text: at minimum GitHub tokens (ghp_, gho_, ghs_, ghu_, github_pat_), AWS access key ids (AKIA plus 16 uppercase alphanumerics), PEM private-key headers, Slack tokens (xoxb-/xoxa-/xoxp-/xoxr-/xoxs-), Authorization: Bearer with 20 or more characters, and a generic assignment of api_key/token/secret/password to a 20-plus character value; clean text returns an empty list. Run it over the receipt AND the worker stdout together. When it is clean, write docs/evidence/receipts/<task_id>/receipt.json and docs/evidence/receipts/<task_id>/worker-stdout.txt inside the worktree, so the commit picks them up. The committed receipt.json must have the worker's stdout REMOVED and a short marker naming the sidecar and its byte count left in its place; worker-stdout.txt holds the transcript as text, with its own newlines intact -- embedding it in JSON is what produced a 288 KB single line and broke ripgrep in every worker clone. When the scan finds anything, write NEITHER file, record the withholding and the pattern names under report["pr"]["receipt"], and carry on: a secret in a transcript must not turn a green packet into a failed one. The receipt the driver already writes beside the worktree is unchanged and keeps its stdout; only the committed copy is split. Generate the PR body to its own file and point gh pr create --body-file at that, never at the receipt. The body carries the task id, the starting_commit, the disposition, a gate table of every gate name and its boolean, the worker's cost and tokens, and the repo-relative path of the captured receipt or the withheld notice. It must be under 65536 bytes no matter how large the receipt is, and must contain no transcript. A failed capture sets report["pr"]["failed_step"] to "receipt-capture", escalates once as the pr step, exits non-zero and reaches nothing after it. A dry run captures nothing. A non-candidate disposition and every L-2 stop condition reach no capture. Do NOT identify the PR sub-steps by their position in PR_STEP_NAMES: each must report its own name, or a later insertion shifts them all again. Change nothing else.
required_outcomes: PR_STEP_NAMES leads with receipt-capture, then commit, remote-add, push, pr-create
the PR body is generated, always under 65536 bytes, and contains no transcript
the committed receipt.json has the stdout removed and worker-stdout.txt holds it as text
the secret scan runs over both and withholds both on any finding, without failing the run
each PR sub-step failure reports its own name, not a positional neighbour
a dry run, a non-candidate disposition and every stop condition reach no capture

acceptance_properties.requirement: the body fits and says enough
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the body exceeds 65536 bytes for any receipt, or omits the task, sha, disposition, gate table, cost or receipt path

acceptance_properties.requirement: no transcript ever reaches a PR body
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a marker planted in the worker stdout appears anywhere in the body

acceptance_properties.requirement: the transcript is text, not a JSON string
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the committed receipt.json still carries the stdout, or worker-stdout.txt is missing or escaped

acceptance_properties.requirement: a secret withholds both files and fails nothing
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a scanned pattern is written to the branch, the finding names leak the matched text, or the run turns red
failing any of the five reports a different step's name

acceptance_properties.requirement: nothing that is not a real hand-off captures
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a dry run, a non-candidate disposition or any stop condition writes a receipt into the worktree

non_goals: the .ignore files and the seven rewritten reports, already landed as coordinator work in the §3c hand-pass
the receipt the driver writes beside the worktree, which keeps its stdout
